title: Cambay (Khambat) location of Akbar's farman
subject: History
caption: Map of Gujarat highlighting Cambay (Khambat), the location of Akbar's 1598 farman allowing a church to be built.
altText: A textbook-quality map of Gujarat, India on a white background. The state outline is shown with faint shading to suggest terrain. Major cities such as Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Cambay (Khambat) are labeled in black text. Cambay is marked with a bright red star, and a callout box adjacent to it displays a small parchment icon and the caption "1598 – Akbar's farman permitting the construction of a church". A north arrow and scale bar are included in the lower left corner, and a legend explains the symbols. The illustration is high resolution, accurate, and clearly labelled.
